notes: Prague-based early-stage VC of the J&T group (office in J&T Banka building). Definic (Košice, SK) is a Slovak deal. Website states €120M assets and region CEE & SEE & Baltics, but those are short standalone labels, so AUM was not recorded. Not the same entity as c048 J&T ARCH Investments.
